page.overview:
Who is Jaygarcia Saturn?

Saint Jaygarcia Saturn was a World Noble who served as one of the Five Elders publicly heading the World Government. A scientist by trade, he held the title Warrior God of Science and Defense during his tenure.

Living for over two centuries, Saturn was a central figure in the Egghead Incident, where he personally led the Marine siege on Egghead with the goal of assassinating Dr. Vegapunk. However, due to Saturn's failure to stop Monkey D. Luffy from escaping, Nerona Imu stripped him of his immortality, resulting in his death. His position as one of the Five Elders was granted to Figarland Garling.

Due to his actions and role, Saturn served as the main antagonist of the Egghead Arc and one of the overarching antagonists of the One Piece series, along with the other Elders, until his death.

Saturn was a heavyset elderly man with a full white mustache and beard. Atop his white hair which resembled a traditional judge wig sat a square black hat. He had a scar on the left side of his face, stretching diagonally over his eye. Like two of his fellow Elders, his outfit consisted of a black suit over a dark purple tie and a white collared shirt, as well as black pants. He carried a walking cane.
